exposure: Intrapartum antibiotic prophylaxis (IAP) for Group B Streptococcus (GBS)
cohort: Infants born at full term gestation to women with uncomplicated pregnancies
finding: Exposure of infants to IAP for GBS during vaginal birth affected aspects of gut microbial ecology that, although dramatic at early time points, disappeared by 12 weeks of age in most infants.
mod_finding: Infants born by C-section had altered gut colonization, including a notable lack of Bacteroidetes.
